selection_method: Python 3 random.Random(seed); category order is developer, communication, media, retail, productivity, finance, travel, publishing_community; choose one from each three-site category, then sample four without replacement from the remaining 16. Candidate order is the JSON array order.
selection_constraints: All selected before observing Oak runtime results.
No result-dependent replacement; redirects, access blocks, and failures remain in the dataset.
No account registration, credentials, payments, trading, or login submissions to real account sites.
Candidate login URLs contain no query string or fragment.
Popular/recognizable sites are a qualitative category-diverse convenience pool, not a traffic-weighted statistical sample.
